column1: # English words Nepali speakers routinely write in Devanagari, spelled the way
# Nepali spells them. They are not reachable through the Nepali phonetic
# rules, because English spelling says little about English sound: "phone"
# would come out फोने and "video" भिदेओ. Typed on the Nepali phonetic layout,
# the English spelling on the left resolves straight to the Nepali form on the
# right, ahead of the rules and of the dictionary. Nepali writes English v as
# भ (भिडियो, भिसा) and the open a as या (म्याच, क्यामेरा).
# Only loanwords: an English word Nepali has its own word for is not here,
# since typing "news" should not answer with समाचार.
